name: get_api_schema
description: OpenAPI description of the exposed tables, views, columns and functions (needs a secret or service_role key since Feb 2026)

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

name: select_rows
description: Read rows of a table or view with filters, column selection (incl. related tables) and ordering; row level security applies to publishable/anon keys

table.description: Table or view name in the exposed schema

columns.description: Columns to return in PostgREST select syntax, e.g. id,title,author:profiles(name) (default all)

filters.description: Conditions, all must match: [{column, operator, value, negate?, language?}]. operator: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, match, imatch, in, is, isdistinct, fts, plfts, phfts, wfts, cs, cd, ov, sl, sr, nxr, nxl, adj. Values are quoted for you; "in" takes a list, "is" takes null/true/false/unknown, like/ilike use * as wildcard, language is for full-text operators. JSON columns: data->>city

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

name: insert_rows
description: Insert one or more rows and return them; missing columns get their defaults (as an agent tool only when SUPABASE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

table.description: Table or view name in the exposed schema

rows.description: Rows as objects of column: value

columns.description: Columns to return in PostgREST select syntax, e.g. id,title,author:profiles(name) (default all)

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

name: upsert_rows
description: Insert rows, or update (merge) or skip (ignore) rows whose primary key or on_conflict columns already exist (as an agent tool only when SUPABASE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

table.description: Table or view name in the exposed schema

on_conflict.description: Columns of a UNIQUE constraint to match on, e.g. email (default the primary key)

duplicates.description: merge updates existing rows, ignore leaves them

columns.description: Columns to return in PostgREST select syntax, e.g. id,title,author:profiles(name) (default all)

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

name: update_rows
description: Set column values on every row matching the filters (at least one filter required) and return the changed rows (as an agent tool only when SUPABASE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

table.description: Table or view name in the exposed schema

filters.description: Conditions, all must match: [{column, operator, value, negate?, language?}]. operator: eq, neq, gt, gte, lt, lte, like, ilike, match, imatch, in, is, isdistinct, fts, plfts, phfts, wfts, cs, cd, ov, sl, sr, nxr, nxl, adj. Values are quoted for you; "in" takes a list, "is" takes null/true/false/unknown, like/ilike use * as wildcard, language is for full-text operators. JSON columns: data->>city

columns.description: Columns to return in PostgREST select syntax, e.g. id,title,author:profiles(name) (default all)

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

name: call_function
description: Call a Postgres function exposed by the Data API (RPC) with named arguments (as an agent tool only when SUPABASE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

db_schema.description: Schema when the Data API exposes several (default public)

name: list_buckets
description: Storage buckets of the project with their public flag, size limit and allowed MIME types

name: list_objects
description: Files and folders under a prefix of a bucket (one level), with size and MIME type in metadata

prefix.description: Folder to list, e.g. "invoices/2026" ("" for the root)

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous call, to get the next page

name: get_object_info
description: Size, MIME type, ETag and timestamps of one file

object_path.description: Object path inside the bucket, e.g. invoices/2026/11.pdf

name: upload_object
description: Upload a file (https URL or a path inside SUPABASE_UPLOAD_DIR) to a bucket path; upsert overwrites (node only) (as an agent tool only when SUPABASE_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1)

object_path.description: Object path inside the bucket, e.g. invoices/2026/11.pdf

file.description: File (an https URL, or an absolute path inside the plugin's upload directory)

upsert.description: Overwrite an existing file (workflow nodes only)

name: api_request
description: Call any Supabase project API (Data API /rest/v1, Storage /storage/v1) endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/rest/v1/<table>?select=id&id=eq.1". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/rest/v1/<table>?select=id&id=eq.1"
